De novo VHH, CDR3 AARPSSRSGSDDWDY. De novo VHH on the caplacizumab framework against HER2 domain IV, hotspots from the trastuzumab epitope. In the refolded Boltz-2 pose it sits on that epitope (3/4 hotspot atoms within 4.5 A, 79% of its footprint inside trastuzumab's). Passes <70% CDR identity against the SAbDab2 ML subset only; the nearest-neighbour identity is at chance level (shuffled-loop control median 0.61). `pass` is empty (missing pose-RMSD evidence); scores are single-sample and not comparable with the CDRH3 track. Hard filters pass (2 Cys = the framework pair, 120 aa). Designed-residue hydrophobic fraction 0.30, net charge -1; Gly/Pro in designed residues 4/1 (stability proxy only, not a Tm prediction). Motif screen: no hits.
